column1: # UNGRADED.tsv -- rosetta-prolog: shipped Rosetta solutions owed work before they can be graded -- a driver (NEEDS_DRIVER: it defines
# its solution and never calls it, or the oracle prints nothing), a graded run under the build timeout (TIMEOUT), or a harness that
# can hold a carriage return in a ref (NEEDS_RUNNER_WIRING). name<TAB>CLASS<TAB>evidence, measured 2026-10-09.
